title: Expert info: check group and severity
description: Add a check for valid group and severity values, and fix violations foud.

notes.body:
I wasn't sure if the check (in expert.c) ought to be done every time the dissectors are registered, or only in checked builds (e.g. inside a #ifdef ENABLE_CHECK_FILTER guard like the conflict checks in proto.c).

And if it is done all of the time, I guess returning early wouldn't be an option, as that expert info could still be emitted...

None of this would be needed if the group and severity values were a proper enum type. We could have made it easier if the values' names contained _GROUP_ or _SEVERITY_.  One last source of confusion (at least for me) is that in proto.h, the severity entries are listed before the group ones, whereas they appear in the opposite order in expert_field.

@@ -353,6 +353,37 @@ expert_free_deregistered_expertinfos (void)
 static int
 expert_register_field_init(expert_field_info *expinfo, expert_module_t *module)
 {
+	/* Check for valid group and severity vals */
+	switch (expinfo->group) {
+		case PI_CHECKSUM:
+		case PI_SEQUENCE:
+		case PI_RESPONSE_CODE:
+		case PI_REQUEST_CODE:
+		case PI_UNDECODED:
+		case PI_REASSEMBLE:
+		case PI_MALFORMED:
+		case PI_DEBUG:
+		case PI_PROTOCOL:
+		case PI_SECURITY:
+		case PI_COMMENTS_GROUP:
+		case PI_DECRYPTION:
+		case PI_ASSUMPTION:
+		case PI_DEPRECATED:
+			break;
+		default:
+			REPORT_DISSECTOR_BUG("Expert info for %s has invalid group=0x%08x\n", expinfo->name, expinfo->group);
+	}
+	switch (expinfo->severity) {
+		case PI_COMMENT:
+		case PI_CHAT:
+		case PI_NOTE:
+		case PI_WARN:
+		case PI_ERROR:
+			break;
+		default:
+			REPORT_DISSECTOR_BUG("Expert info for %s has invalid severity=0x%08x\n", expinfo->name, expinfo->severity);
+	}
+
 	expinfo->protocol      = module->proto_name;
 
 	/* if we always add and never delete, then id == len - 1 is correct */
